title: Open-Meteo ERA5 archive — Auburn, 24–25 April, 2015–2025
claims: For Auburn on 24–25 April in 2015–2025 there are 22 daily records: daily maximum 13.1–28.6 °C (median 18.8 °C), daily minimum 5.9–14.0 °C (median 8.6 °C), 5 days with at least 1 mm precipitation and 3 days with at least 5 mm.
The station is Auburn town, not the China Wall trailhead or the Western States Trail canyons.

verification.note: Daily values retrieved and filtered to 24–25 April; medians and wet-day counts calculated locally.
